Inspect key figures and methods. Check relevant earlier work when novelty is central.<br><br>Apply evidence standards suited to the paper type." style="rounded=1;arcSize=10;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#666666;strokeWidth=1.4;fontFamily=Arial;fontSize=18;fontColor=#243444;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=16;fontSize=17;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="630" y="1100" width="540" height="190" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="31" value="<b><font style="font-size:20px">Check twice; deliver readable analysis</font></b><br><br>Pass 1: claims, numbers, units, and sources.<br>Pass 2: terms, inference steps, and repetition.<br><br>Save self-contained UTF-8 Markdown with clear judgments, Q&amp;A, six beats, and principles." style="rounded=1;arcSize=10;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;strokeWidth=1.4;fontFamily=Arial;fontSize=18;fontColor=#243444;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=16;fontSize=17;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="1210" y="1100" width="540" height="190" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="32" value="<b>QUALITY STANDARD</b> Direct judgments • Evidence-matched claims • Explained inference steps • Focused boundaries • Connected prose" style="rounded=1;arcSize=10;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=none;strokeColor=none;strokeWidth=1.4;fontFamily=Arial;fontSize=18;fontColor=#243444;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=16;spacing=0;fontSize=19;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="50" y="1315" width="1700" height="45" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="33" value="<font color="#666666">●</font> Sources / tools <font color="#6c8ebf">●</font> Question / design <font color="#d6b656">●</font> Evidence / claims <font color="#9673a6">●</font> Story <font color="#82b366">●</font> Learning / output <b>→</b> analysis flow <b>⇢</b> revision loop" style="rounded=1;arcSize=10;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=none;strokeColor=none;strokeWidth=1.4;fontFamily=Arial;fontSize=18;fontColor=#243444;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=16;spacing=0;fontSize=16;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="50" y="1380" width="1700" height="30" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

START WITH THE PAPER Full text + figures and captions + key methods; supplement when needed.
Keep a compact evidence record: claim → key result → source location. Abstract-only input supports a provisional analysis.

Develop beats 1–2 fully: what was already known, at which scale, and where the reasoning stopped. Then show how the design and evidence change that understanding.
Keep pre-study knowledge distinct from the paper’s discoveries.

Use tools to verify sources
Read local files or retrieve the known paper. Inspect key figures and methods. Check relevant earlier work when novelty is central.
Apply evidence standards suited to the paper type.
